response.sql:
WITH player_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    a.player_id,
    p.death_country,
    SUM(a.g_1b - a.g_cf) as total
  FROM appearances a
  JOIN player p ON a.player_id = p.player_id
  WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL 
    AND p.death_country != ''
    AND a.g_1b IS NOT NULL 
    AND a.g_cf IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY a.player_id, p.death_country
),
average_total AS (
  SELECT AVG(total) as avg_total FROM player_totals
)
SELECT 
  SUM(pt.total) as sum_of_totals,
  AVG(pt.total - at.avg_total) as avg_excess
FROM player_totals pt
CROSS JOIN average_total at
WHERE pt.total > at.avg_total

assumptions.assumption: "recorded, non-blank death_country" is interpreted as death_country IS NOT NULL AND death_country != '' (two distinct conditions: not null and not empty string), rather than only requiring IS NOT NULL.

alternatives.interpretation: "recorded, non-blank death_country" could mean only IS NOT NULL if "recorded" and "non-blank" are treated as synonymous descriptions of data presence (i.e., null is considered "blank").
